content: + News (TL Sentence Encoders) + NRA: Makes use of sentence encoders of our two auxiliary TL tasks as fixed features. This baseline aims to address the following questions, namely: What dataset and models are more suitable to transfer to our specific volatility forecasting problem; How End-to-End models, which are trained on top of word embeddings, perform compared to sentence encoders transferred from other tasks.
